headline: Covid season vibes?
body: I don't know if its just me but I cba with this game after this enormous break. When you've also got the looming presence of the 114/115 whatever it is and how that might pan out too. Like they could literally get ejected this season (unlikely maybe) and leave somebody a blank gw every week. Even if its points, what would -80 plus points potentially do to City mentally? They will be checked out as fuck. Feels like another asterisk covid season to me   submitted by   /u/Most-Temperature2883 [link]   [comments]
